q: O you wrapped in a shawl!
v.s: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
v.c: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺!

q: (them about Allaah's punishment for rejecting Imaan).
v.s: Arise and warn.
v.c: Arise and warn ˹all˺.

q: Announce the greatness of your Rabb
(which is a most important point of your message).
v.s: And your Lord glorify.
v.c: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺.

q: (When preaching Towheed, mind your appearance and ensure that you)
v.s: And your clothing purify.
v.c: Purify your garments.

q: (idols and sin, as you have always been doing).
v.s: And uncleanliness avoid.
v.c: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols.

q: to others with the intention of receiving back more
(from them as a token of thanks).
v.s: And do not confer favor to acquire more.
v.c: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺.

q: (endure the taunts and opposition of the Kuffaar)
(for He will reward you abundantly for it).
v.s: But for your Lord be patient.
v.c: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord.

v.s: And when the trumpet is blown,
v.c: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded,

q: ...that day will be an extremely severe day...
v.s: That Day will be a difficult day
v.c: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—

q: ...for the Kaafiroon and it will not be easy.
v.s: For the disbelievers - not easy.
v.c: far from easy for the disbelievers.

q: (Referring specifically to Waleed bin Mughiera, one of Rasulullaah ﷺ worst enemies, and to all such Kuffaar in general, Allaah says,))
Leave Me (to deal) with the one
whom I have created single- handedly...
v.s: Leave Me with the one I created alone
v.c: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself,

q: ...and to whom I have granted ever increasing wealth...
v.s: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
v.c: and granted him abundant wealth,

v.s: And children present [with him]
v.c: and children always by his side,

q: ...and for whom I have prepared every type of comfort.
v.s: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
v.c: and made life very easy for him.

q: He then wishes that I grant him even more
v.s: Then he desires that I should add more.
v.c: Yet he is hungry for more.

q: (shall he receive any good in the Aakhirah)!
v.s: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
v.c: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations.

q: I shall soon make him climb a mountain of Jahannam.

(Rasulullaah ﷺ said that the mountain refers to a mountain of fire in Jahannam that will take a person seventy years to climb and another seventy years to descend. This will continue forever without any respite.)
v.s: I will cover him with arduous torment.
v.c: I will make his fate unbearable,

q: (when Waleed was asked about the Qur'aan)
(about what to say so that the Mushrikeen are not displeased, even though he knew that the Qur'aan was truly Allaah's word)
(and announced that the Qur'aan was magic and that Rasulullaah ﷺ was a magician).
v.s: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
v.c: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺.

q: May he be destroyed! How does he plot?
v.s: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
v.c: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined!

q: May he be destroyed again! How does he plot?
v.s: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
v.c: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined!

q: (at the Mushrikeen waiting for his reply)...
v.s: Then he considered [again];
v.c: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺,

v.s: Then he frowned and scowled;
v.c: then frowned and scowled,

q: Then he turned away and was proud.
v.s: Then he turned back and was arrogant
v.c: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly,

q: He said, “This is nothing but magic recounted
v.s: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
v.c: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients.

v.s: This is not but the word of a human being."
v.c: This is no more than the word of a man.”

v.s: I will drive him into Saqar.
v.c: Soon I will burn him in Hell!

q: What shall inform you what Jahannam is?
v.s: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
v.c: And what will make you realize what Hell is?

v.s: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
v.c: It does not let anyone live or die,

q: (by burning and making the skin red).
v.s: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
v.c: scorching the skin.

v.s: Over it are nineteen [angels].
v.c: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺.

q: only angels as the keepers of the Fire
(because each of them is individually stronger than all of mankind and Jinn, and because they never disobey Allaah).
only a test for the Kaafiroon
(to see who scoffs at the number)
so that the People of the Book may be convinced
(about the truth of the Qur'aan because the same number is mentioned in their divine scriptures)
and so that the Mu'mineen may be increased in Imaan
(by believing in another verse of the Qur'aan). (The number has been fixed at nineteen)
So that the People of the Book and the Mu'mineen may not doubt
and so that those with diseased
and the Kaafiroon may say, “What does Allaah intend with this
example?” Thus does Allaah send astray whoever He wills
and guides whoever He wills. Only He
knows the armies of your Rabb
(the number of angels and other forces He uses).
v.s: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, “What does God intend by this as an example?” Thus does God leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
v.c: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity.

q: by the oath of the moon!
v.s: No! By the moon.
v.c: But no! By the moon,

q: And by the oath of the night when it retreats
(at dawn to make way for day light)!
v.s: And [by] the night when it departs.
v.c: and the night as it retreats,

q: And by the oath of the morning when it gets bright!
v.s: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
v.c: and the day as it breaks!

v.s: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].
v.c: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—

q: (that he should avoid everything that leads to it)...
v.s: As a warning to humanity -
v.c: a warning to humankind,

q: for those of you who wish to advance
and those who wish to retreat
v.s: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
v.c: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind.

q: Every soul shall be held back
v.s: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.
v.c: Every soul will be detained for what it has done,
v.h: What Leads the Wicked to Hell

q: ...except for the people of the right
(those who will receive their records of actions in their right hands).
v.s: Except the companions of the right,.
v.c: except the people of the right,

q: They will be in Jannaat asking...
v.s: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
v.c: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

v.s: About the criminals,
v.c: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺:

v.s: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
v.c: “What has landed you in Hell?”

q: They will reply, “We were not among those who performed salaah...”
v.s: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
v.c: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed,

q: “...and we did not feed the poor.”
v.s: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
v.c: nor did we feed the poor.

v.s: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
v.c: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others,

q: “...and we used to deny the Day of Reckoning...”
v.s: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
v.c: and deny the Day of Judgment,

q: (only then did we realise the error of our ways, but it was too late).”
v.s: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
v.c: until the inevitable came to us.”

q: The intercession of intercessors will not help them
(because no one will be allowed to intercede on their behalf).
v.s: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
v.c: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them.

q: What is the matter with them that they turn away from the Advice
v.s: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.
v.c: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder,

q: that they seem like wild donkeys...
v.s: As if they were alarmed donkeys.
v.c: as if they were spooked zebras

v.s: Fleeing from a lion?
v.c: fleeing from a lion?

q: each one of them waits to be given open scrolls
(from the heavens, clearly commanding them to follow him).
v.s: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
v.c: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺.

q: they have no fear for the Aakhirah.
v.s: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
v.c: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter.

v.s: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.
v.c: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder.

q: So whoever wills should take heed
(because there shall be no separate book for each one).
v.s: Then whoever wills will remember it.
v.c: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.

q: They cannot take heed unless Allaah wills. It is He Who should be feared and He Who forgives.
v.s: And they will not remember except that God wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
v.c: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive.
